sequential_note: After each singleton intersection is backdriven into the grid, the remaining initially ambiguous (1,0) cell collapses as well; the complete test grid is obtained without branching.
interpretation: The row-side and column-side local models are individually incomplete on several cells, but their shared exact compatibility fiber plus backdriving collapses all six missing test cells. This is a concrete local forward/backward singularity mechanism rather than simple inverse mapping.
claim_boundary: The Latin/permutation schema is inferred and verified from the three training outputs within a small hand-chosen generic schema family. This is an exact microscope, not yet evidence that the general ARC learner will autonomously discover this semantic family on arbitrary tasks.
